paragraphs: The portfolio has two presentations sharing the same routes and content. First visits use the dashboard. Choose Terminal Mode beside the theme selector or in the mobile header to enter the monochrome terminal; Dashboard Mode or exit returns to the same page with the previous theme preference.

The console starts closed. Open Terminal slides a full-width panel up over the page and focuses its inline prompt; command names appear blue and arguments amber. Drag the top edge to resize, or focus the separator and use Up/Down (Shift for larger steps), Home/End, or double-click to reset. The console header stays stationary while output scrolls. Close hides the entire panel and restores launcher focus; Escape dismisses suggestions first, then closes the panel. Presentation choice persists in localStorage. History and draft input survive navigation and mode switches; preferred panel height…

For a server on a custom port, set DASHBOARDBASEURL for dashboard and terminal checks, THEMEVISUALBASEURL for theme checks, and PROJECTVISUALBASEURL for project checks. Each value should include the trailing slash, e.g.
